## Learning path

1. **Foundations · Weeks 1–2:** computational concepts, Python, and Markov decision processes.
2. **Solving models · Weeks 3–8:** value and policy iteration, Euler equations, endogenous grids, and simulation.
3. **Learning and applications · Weeks 9–13:** approximation, machine learning, reinforcement learning, and heterogeneous-agent models.

[Start with Week 1](weeks/week_01/index.qmd) · [View all 13 weeks](syllabus.qmd)

## Course updates

The course materials are being revised week by week. Existing lecture handouts and labs are available through the sidebar. Weekly pages indicate where material is still being prepared. Dates and deadlines for the next offering will be announced separately.
